definitions: Actively and productively engaged in a task or activity.
Full of activity or people; bustling.
Occupied with work or a task to the exclusion of other things.
Having a great deal to do.
In use; occupied (of a telephone line, toilet, etc.).
Too full of detail or ornamentation; cluttered.
examples: She's always busy with her projects.
The market was very busy today.
I'm busy, can I call you back?
The wallpaper pattern is too busy.
